build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cargo build --release -p forager-cli

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; worker-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Install and update apps from their forge releases
bundle.longDescription: Tracks apps on GitHub, GitLab and Codeberg, picks the release asset that fits this system, verifies it, and installs it with the system package manager, as a Flatpak, an AppImage or a tarball.
